title: 第84章 一笔大生意，杀炎文帝！
novel_title: 唐逸孔诗岚全文完结版
content_zh: 与此同时，北城一间客栈中。一个身材魁梧的男人抱着长刀站在窗前，望着灯火摇曳的京都，嘴角的笑容冰冷如刀。“舵主，暗京楼的一半高手，全都秘密潜到京都了，我们到底要干啥？搞这么大动静。”男人是暗京楼京都分舵的八大高手之一，孙霸。他扭了扭脖子，手敲了敲长刀道：“我接了杀唐逸的任务，虽然那只是五千两，但苍蝇腿也是肉吧？”“你斩公子不差钱，可老子差，老子还要养家呢。”孙霸身后，正坐着一个青年。青年一身白衣，容颜俊美，只是脸色有些苍白，看上去仿佛大病初愈，一手捻着手帕不断咳嗽，一手正捻着棋子，在棋盘上自己博弈。正是暗京楼京都分舵舵主，龙斩。“咳咳……养家？也是，你要养的女人没有一百也有八十个了。”龙斩手中白棋落在棋盘上，擦了擦嘴角，又从棋篓中捻起一颗黑棋道：“每一个都是你的最爱，每个月的花销，的确有点大。”“只是不能因为你，坏了楼主的大计。”“虽然唐逸不是什么重要的人物，但现在是锦衣卫，又和燕王萧棣有牵扯，杀了他要是萧棣动用锦衣卫追查下来，可能会暴露我们的目的。”孙霸愕然看向唐逸，道：“这是啥意思？我们的目的，到底是啥目的？”龙斩手帕捂着嘴轻咳两声，笑道：“你不是需要钱吗？楼主与东虞和北狄谈了一笔大生意，做完这笔大生意，你往后十年，不，是这辈子都可以不用接单了。”“这笔大生意，便是杀炎文帝。”“至于唐逸，他反正也参加沈园诗会，到时候你再随手宰了做添头就是。”孙霸一怔，然后瞬间跳了起来。“杀炎文帝？真的假的？”他舔着嘴唇，满脸激动：“哈哈，这个任务够刺激，我参与，老子必须参与！”“这老家伙可值钱了，暗榜上的悬赏金都快到百万两了。”“再加上其他奖励，老子就可以金盆洗手了。”孙霸看向龙斩，挥动拳头道：“舵主，这一票太大了，我都已经热血沸腾了。”“咱们暗京楼这次几乎全军出动，别说在炎文帝出宫杀他，就是在冲杀皇宫，咱们也有十足的把握啊！”“干脆，咱们宰了狗皇帝，让楼主当皇帝算了。”“咳咳咳……”龙斩一连咳嗽几声，手中的棋子都落了地：“嗯，想法很好，下次别想了。”想什么呢？暗京楼只会杀人，救天下治理天下这种事，他们不会啊！再说谁说杀了皇帝，楼主就能做皇帝了？大炎的满朝文武都不会答应好吧，敢登基不出三天，天下皆反。孙霸回头看向龙斩，当场瞪眼：“为啥不能想？这次行动是舵主你指挥，咱们暗京楼两百多人参加哎！”“两百多个高手，杀都能将炎文帝杀到胆寒。”龙斩微微摇头，杀到炎文帝胆寒？你也太小看炎文帝了。炎文帝那么好杀，东虞和北狄会花那么大的代价，让暗京楼来做这件事？更何况炎文帝的锦衣卫和大内高手，可不是那么好惹的。虽然他们在皇宫有内应，但这些棋子不到万不得已，是不能用的。“少废话，接待隐匿暗京楼杀手的事，你全权负责。”龙斩敲了敲桌案，冷眸盯着孙霸道：“敢擅自行动，敢不听号令，信不信我先杀你祭旗？”看着龙斩眼底的寒意，孙霸顿时打了一个激灵，眼前这青年虽然看上去半死不活，但他很清楚对方有多狠毒。这几年在他手中被削成人彘的人，没有一百也有八十了。他可不想成为下一个。“是，舵主，我一定不给你惹麻烦。”孙霸连忙抬手发誓保证。……姜家府外，湖畔小道。姜云娜抱着唐画的手，正在小道上散步。唐逸拒绝婚约后，姜御史和唐敬要谈事，送姜云娜回家的重任自然就落在了唐画的身上。此时，姜云娜看着唐画俊逸的侧脸，脸上有些自责。“对不起，画哥哥，都怪我，我没控制好情绪，让唐逸看出来了，才导致计划失败……”唐画听到这话，眼底有冷意闪过。愚蠢的女人，要不是你处处维护我，计划岂会失败？只是他眼底的冷意迅速敛去，嘴角泛起和煦的笑容。抬手揉了揉姜云娜的脑袋，唐画满脸溺爱道：“没关系，这不怪你，你在意我，我高兴还来不及呢。”“至于唐逸，我们有的是机会收拾他。”姜云娜用力点头，小鸟依人靠在唐画的肩膀上：“画哥哥才华横溢，娜娜相信画哥哥必定一飞冲天，平步青云的。”“唐逸哥哥放心，唐逸要是胆敢挡画哥哥的路，我一定不惜一切代价让他后悔的！”想到唐逸在唐家拔刀的嚣张模样，姜云娜眼中充满怨毒，一个不受宠的废物，想要挡画哥哥和我的路？简直不知死活。还大言不惭想要娶孔诗岚？做梦吧！唐画脸上泛起一抹厌恶，一个御史的女儿，也想和她花前月下？你也配？玩物罢了！要不是你还有用，是用来践踏唐逸尊严的玩具，真以为我还需要对你笑脸相迎？“我知道，但唐逸太过恶毒，我们不得不防。”唐画轻叹一口气，道：“他现在勾搭上那小诗仙，要是和小诗仙联手谋害我，可能会导致沈园诗会，出现一些意外。”“唐逸大闹庆功宴，已经让我成了京都的笑话。”“要是沈园诗会出现意外，陛下又在场，陛下恐怕会对我有不好的印象。”唐画双手捧着姜云娜的脸，道：“娜娜，我这里还有一计，需要你配合下，就是对你的名节会有点影响，我不忍心。”“哎，算了，剩下的事情交给我就是了。”姜云娜双手抓住唐画捧着她脸的手，面上爬上一抹红晕：“画哥哥，我早就是你的人了，只要能够帮你，损失一点点名节又怎么样呢。”“画哥，你就告诉我，我需要怎么做吧！”唐画将姜云娜抱在怀里，嘴角泛起一抹阴谋得逞的笑容：“很简单，我这里有药，我需要你……将唐逸弄到床上去！”“然后，捉奸，让他不得不娶你。”呵，唐逸，你狂妄什么？我要你娶一个我玩剩下的垃圾！姜云娜点点头，道：“好，我明日找机会弄晕他！”
content_en: At the same time, in an inn in Beicheng.A burly man stood in front of the window holding a long knife, looking at the swaying lights of Kyoto, with a smile as cold as a knife."Master, half of the masters of Anjing Tower have secretly sneaked into Kyoto. What are we going to do? Make such a big noise." The man is Sun Ba, one of the eight masters of Anjing Tower's Kyoto branch.He twisted his neck, tapped the long knife with his hand and said: "I took over the task of killing Tang Yi. Although it was only five thousand taels, the fly's legs are also meat, right?" "You don't need money to kill the young master, but I don't. I have to support my family." Behind Sun Ba, a young man was sitting.The young man was dressed in white and had a handsome face, but his face was a little pale. He looked as if he had just recovered from a serious illness. He was twisting a handkerchief in one hand and coughing, while he was twisting the chess pieces in the other hand and playing games by himself on the chessboard.It was none other than the helmsman of the Kyoto branch of Anjing Tower, Long Zhan."Ahem... support the family? That's right. You have eighty rather than one hundred women to support." The white chess piece in Long Zhan's hand fell on the chessboard, he wiped the corner of his mouth, then picked up a black chess piece from the chess basket and said, "Everyone is your favorite, and the monthly expenses are indeed a bit"Big.""It's just because of you that the poster's plan can't be ruined.""Although Tang Yi is not an important person, he is now a Jinyiwei and is involved with Yan Wang Xiao Di. If Xiao Di uses Jinyiwei to track him down, our purpose may be exposed.Sun Ba looked at Tang Yi in shock and said, "What does this mean? What is our purpose?"Long Zhan covered his mouth with a handkerchief and coughed twice, and said with a smile, "Don't you need money? The poster has negotiated a big deal with Dongyu and Beidi. After completing this big deal, youIn the next ten years, no, I won't have to take orders for the rest of my life."This big deal is to kill Emperor Yan Wen.""As for Tang Yi, he is also participating in the Shen Yuan Poetry Festival. Then you can just kill him and make him his head."Sun Ba was startled, and then jumped up."Kill Emperor Yan Wen? Really or not?" He licked his lips, his face full of excitement: "Haha, this mission is exciting enough. I am participating, and I must participate!" "This old guy is worth a lot of money. The bounty on the secret list is almost one million taels." "Add in other rewards, I can wash my hands in a golden basin." Sun Ba looked at Long Zhan, waved his fist and said, "Captain, this vote is too big, I have already given it.My blood is boiling." "This time, almost all our troops from the Anjing Tower are dispatched.Not to mention killing Emperor Yan Wen, we are fully confident in attacking the palace!" "Let's just kill the dog emperor and let the owner become the emperor." "Ahem..." Long Zhan coughed several times and the chess pieces in his hand fell to the ground. "Well, that's a good idea.Don't think about it next time."Anjing Tower can only kill people, but they can't do things like save the world and govern the world!Besides, who said that if you kill the emperor, you can become the emperor?The civil and military officials of the Great Yan Dynasty would not agree. If they dare to ascend the throne within three days, the whole world will rebel.Sun Ba turned back to look at Long Zhan and glared on the spot: "Why can't you think about it? This operation is commanded by you, the helmsman, and more than two hundred people from Anjing Tower are participating!" "More than two hundred masters can kill Emperor Yanwen to the point of fear." Long Zhan shook his head slightly, killing Emperor Yanwen to the point of being scared?You underestimate Emperor Yanwen too much.Emperor Yanwen is so easy to kill, why would Dongyu and Beidi pay such a high price to let An Jinglou do this?What's more, Emperor Yanwen's Jinyiwei and Dauchi masters are not so easy to mess with.Although they have internal agents in the palace, these chess pieces cannot be used unless absolutely necessary."Stop talking nonsense, you are solely responsible for the reception of the assassins hiding in the Anjing Tower." Long Zhan knocked on the table and stared at Sun Ba with cold eyes: "If you dare to act without permission, if you dare to disobey orders, believe it or not, I will kill you first to sacrifice the flag?" Seeing the coldness in Long Zhan's eyes, Sun Ba suddenly shivered. Although the young man in front of him looked half-dead, he knew very well how vicious the other party was.In the past few years, as many as eighty people have been cut into pigeons by his hands.He didn't want to be next."Yes, helmsman, I will definitely not cause you any trouble." Sun Ba quickly raised his hand and swore to promise.... Outside Jiang's Mansion, on the lakeside path.Jiang Yunna was holding Tang Hua's hand and walking on the path.After Tang Yi refused the engagement, Jiang Yushi and Tang Jing wanted to discuss matters, so the important task of sending Jiang Yunna home naturally fell on Tang Hua.At this time, Jiang Yunna looked at Tang Huajunyi's side face with some self-blame on her face."I'm sorry, brother Hua, it's all my fault. I didn't control my emotions well and let Tang Yi see it, which led to the failure of the plan..." When Tang Hua heard this, a coldness flashed in his eyes.Stupid woman, if you hadn't defended me at all times, would the plan have failed?But the coldness in his eyes quickly disappeared, and a warm smile appeared at the corner of his mouth.Raising his hand to rub Jiang Yunna's head, Tang Hua said dotingly: "It doesn't matter, it's not your fault. You care about me. It's not too late for me to be happy." "As for Tang Yi, we have plenty of opportunities to deal with him." Jiang Yunna nodded vigorously, and the little bird leaned on Tang Hua's shoulder: "Brother Hua is talented, Nana believes in Hua"Brother Tang Yi, don't worry. If Tang Yi dares to block my brother's way, I will make him regret it at all costs!"Thinking of Tang Yi's arrogant appearance in the Tang family, Jiang Yunna's eyes were full of resentment. An unpopular waste wants to block the way of my brother and me?It's just a matter of life and death.Are you still bragging that you want to marry Kong Shilan?Dream on!A look of disgust appeared on Tang Hua's face. A censor's daughter also wanted to spend time with her?Are you worthy?Just a plaything!If you weren't still useful as a toy used to trample Tang Yi's dignity, do you really think I still need to smile at you?"I know, but Tang Yi is too vicious, and we have to guard against it." Tang Hua sighed softly and said, "He has hooked up with the little poetry fairy now. If he joins forces with the little poetry fairy to murder me, it may cause some accidents at the Shen Yuan Poetry Recital." "Tang Yi's big celebration banquet has made me a joke in Kyoto." "If there is an accident at the Shen Yuan Poetry Reunion and His Majesty is present, Your Majesty may have a bad impression of me.Tang Hua held Jiang Yunna's face with both hands and said, "Nana, I have another plan here. I need your cooperation, but it will affect your reputation. I can't bear it.""Hey, forget it, leave the rest to me."Jiang Yunna grabbed Tang Hua's hand holding her face with both hands, and said with a blush: "Brother Hua, I have been yours for a long time. As long as I can help you, it doesn't matter if I lose a little bit of my reputation."
title_en: Chapter 84 A big deal, kill Emperor Yanwen!
